description: Create a fully formatted Microsoft Excel spreadsheet using AI-generated structured data. Supports headers, data rows, styled header rows, formulas, multiple sheets, and auto-fitted columns.

topic.description: What the spreadsheet should contain (e.g. 'monthly budget tracker', 'student grade sheet')

title.description: Spreadsheet/workbook title. Auto-generated from topic if not provided.

instructions.description: Additional instructions about columns, data, formulas, or layout

filename.description: Where to save the file. Defaults to Desktop with a sanitized title.

sheet_name.description: Name for the main worksheet. Defaults to 'Sheet1'.

example_commands: create an Excel spreadsheet for monthly expenses
make a student grade tracker in Excel
make an inventory tracking sheet in Excel
create a budget planner with totals in Excel
